lede: President Donald J. Trump disclosed 2,514 new trades in this digest, part of 7,699 transactions reported between Jan. 1, 2025, and May 29, 2026, of which 6,337, or 82 percent, were flagged as filed late, meaning notification was certified as received more than 30 days before filing; his most recent purchases include New York City municipal bonds valued at up to $5 million. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin reported 89 transactions, all sales and all flagged late, though his filings carry an Integrity.gov notice of a 45-day extension, so trades flagged late may have been reported within his extended deadline. Federal Highway Administrator Sean McMaster disclosed five recent purchases dated May 13 and May 14, 2026, including Qualcomm and Corning, while Office of Personnel Management Director Scott A. Kupor reported four sales dated June 18, 2026, in Robinhood and Okta valued at up to $5 million. Office of Science and Technology Policy Director Michael J. Kratsios added one purchase, an investment-grade corporate bond ETF valued at up to $15,000.
